info.title: Research Intelligence frontend — BFF HTTP face
info.description: Generated from the zod contract schemas (src/lib/bff/*/schema.ts) by scripts/contract-spec.ts. Do not edit by hand.

get.summary: The Papers page, one page at a time: screening, ordering, search, starred, minimum score, TRL window and ingested window over every domain the user belongs to (?workspace_id= narrows to one), with the rail's corpus-wide facets alongside.
One paper with its workspace summary.

The Ask picker's rows: the papers `q` matches (the shared matcher; empty = best signal first), at most `limit`, as slim rows (title, first author, source, signal) with the matched and total counts. Served from a short per-user cache.
Paginated sessions for the history rail. ?mine=1 keeps only the caller's own rows — Django lists a whole workspace to its admins and managers.
One session with its turns; DELETE removes it; PATCH renames (501 until Django saves it).
Paginated edition summaries; ?workspace_id= narrows to one domain, otherwise every domain the user belongs to.
One edition with exclusions; ?workspace_id= picks the domain (otherwise every domain), ?run_id= picks one of the day's runs (otherwise the day's newest).

patch.summary: Update the profile; refreshes the display cookie.

post.summary: Change the password (field errors come back as problem.errors).

put.summary: The digest-email toggle (?workspace_id=). Stub until Django persists it.
Star or unstar a paper or briefing; responds with the full set.

get.summary: Typeahead over every paper the user can see: ranked hits, matching domains, an Ask action scoped to the top hit; an arXiv id or DOI resolves to one paper.
Paginated view of the user's workspaces in the contract shape.
Paginated runs in the contract shape; ?workspace_id= narrows to one domain, otherwise every domain the user belongs to.

post.summary: Start a briefing run for one of the user's domains; the new run appears at the top of /bff/pipeline-runs as `running`.
Stop a run in flight. 409 once it has already ended, 403 unless the caller is an admin or manager of its domain; the row reads `aborted` on the next /bff/pipeline-runs.

get.summary: Steps of one run in execution order, metrics resolved per step type.

source.description: BFF source that produced the response
